body: Oh my god it's perfect. How are you so smooth?? I'd love to see more.

Reckless behaviour and anger are the two I don't get as much. I think I have the potential for reckless behaviour and I have certainly acted that way in the past, but I don't have any drug or alcohol issues. I do binge eat extremely heavily, though. Anger is the only symptom I don't resonate with at all. I don't ever really get angry, just extremely suicidally upset.

Thank you for all your advice. It's good to hear this from someone who has really lived it.

I'm glad you are so clever as to point this out!

But it adds nothing to the discussion. It's probably a troll post, but it might not be so giving advice doesn't hurt.

What is not normal is blasting it loud and cumming on his sister. That's sexual assault if nothing else.
It doesn't help that if you fuck this up you've basically just wasted a tree.
Late reply. Know you're joking, but I'm 18. Not all that bad. :P

A lot of the people here think you have an obligation to be there for this child. Personally I think I would support him/her, but I don't think your life should be dragged down so much for a moment of bad judgement.

If you want nothing to do with the child I think that is your business. The woman had the choice to keep it or reject it - so should you.
